meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 会深入解释你所提到的任何 senpi 提示（启动提示、工作提示、TUI 中的 Tip 行，含 Fable 5 拒绝后的回退提示）。它先查询实时提示列表，确认你实际可见的提示，再阅读功能源码，用你使用的语言给出具体机制与文件路径。
howto.when: 当你询问某条 Tip 行的含义或功能、说出“give-me-tips”、或想知道自己能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 这条 Tip: 行是什么意思？
say.note: Claude 会先核对你的可见提示列表再回答。

say.text: 给我讲讲刚才看到的那条提示。
say.note: 会阅读相关源码，给出具体机制。

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后的那条提示说了什么？
say.note: 会解释回退架构管道的完整流程。

howto.what_en: Explains any senpi tip the user mentions (startup, working, Tip: lines, Fable-5-refusal fallback). Queries the live tip list first, checks what this user can see, verifies the real code, then explains the mechanism with file paths in the user's language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see.

say_en.text: What does this Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: Checks your visible tips first, then explains.

say_en.text: Tell me about the tip I just saw.
say_en.note: Reads the source and explains the mechanism.

say_en.text: What does the tip after Fable 5 refusal say?
